title: Stop Saying "Very Clean"! 4 Better Ways to Say It #shorts
description:
Don't say "very clean". Say one of these instead:
• Spotless: It's spotless!
• Immaculate: My room is immaculate.
• Pristine: The beach was pristine.
• The idiom: It's as clean as a whistle!

Full lesson: Stop Saying "Very" in English: 30 Words to Use Instead of "Very" (With Pictures)
